about: Breeching inlet modelled as a generic product: red back plate with label, collecting head on brackets, riser outlet and elbow into the wall, gunmetal inlet necks angled 45 degrees down with octagonal male couplings and chrome blank caps, drain valve. The 2-way and 4-way types each carry their own plate, head and inlets (Show parameters).
